title: A Long-Term Extension Study to Learn More About the Safety of Litifilimab (BIIB059) Injections and Whether They Can Improve Symptoms of Adult Participants Who Have Active Cutaneous Lupus Erythematosus (CLE) (AMETHYST LTE)
official: A Multicenter, Open-Label, Single-Arm, Phase 3, Long-Term Extension Study to Evaluate Continuous Safety and Efficacy of BIIB059 (Litifilimab) in Adult Participants With Active Subacute Cutaneous Lupus Erythematosus and/or Chronic Cutaneous Lupus Erythematosus With or Without Systemic Manifestations and Refractory and/or Intolerant to Antimalarial Therapy (AMETHYST LTE)
summary: Main objective: The primary objective of the study is to evaluate the long-term safety and tolerability BIIB059 (litifilimab) in participants who completed the parent study 230LE301 (NCT05531565) with active subacute CLE and/or chronic CLE with or without systemic manifestations and refractory and/or intolerant to antimalarial therapy.
conditions:
1. Lupus Erythematosus, Cutaneous, Subacute
2. Chronic Cutaneous Lupus Erythematosus
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Participants who completed the parent study (230LE301, Part A or Part B) on study treatment (received treatment through Week 48 and attended the last study assessment visit at Week 52) OR Participants who completed Study 230LE305 (up to Year 2) and have been receiving treatment with litifilimab in a sponsored post-trial access program or compassionate use program. Eligibility should be reassessed by the Investigator before re-enrollment, and participants with clinical benefit, in the opinion of the Investigator, may continue study treatment.
2. Ability of the participant to understand the purpose and risks of the study, to provide informed consent, and to authorize the use of confidential health information in accordance with national and local privacy regulations
Exclusion criteria:
1. Participants will be excluded from study entry if any of the following exclusion criteria are present at the time of enrollment in the LTE study: Early Part A or Part B parent study (230LE301) treatment terminators (participants who discontinued study treatment before Week 48)
2. Early Part A or Part B parent study terminators [participants who withdrew from parent study participation before Week 52 and did not complete the parent study extended treatment period (ETP)]
3. Participants who have developed any other medical diseases, conditions, or abnormalities, rendering their participation in the long-term extension (LTE) study unsuitable in the opinion of the Investigator.
4. Other protocol defined Exclusion criteria may apply
